def build(L,seeds,target,Ks,tag):
    W2=W(f'model.layers.{L}.feed_forward.w2.weight'); C=W2/W2.norm(dim=0,keepdim=True)
    W1=W(f'model.layers.{L}.feed_forward.w1.weight'); R=W1/W1.norm(dim=1,keepdim=True)
    sims={k:(C.T@C[:,v].mean(1))*0.5+(R@R[v].mean(0))*0.5 for k,v in seeds.items()}
    others=torch.stack([sims[o] for o in seeds if o!=target]).max(0).values
    score=sims[target]-others

    order=[int(i) for i in score.argsort(descending=True) if int(i) not in allseed]
